**[Critical]** `error` is not declared in scope at this throw site — it only exists as the `catch (error)` parameter inside the catch block below. Optional chaining does NOT suppress `ReferenceError` for undeclared identifiers.

Failure scenario: when the deadline expires between retry iterations (after `await sleep(delayMs)` overshoots the deadline), the loop re-enters with `remainingMs <= 0` and this line throws `ReferenceError: error is not defined` instead of the intended budget-exhausted message. The existing test "shares the time budget across calls" exercises exactly this path and now fails.

Add `let lastError;` before the `for` loop and `lastError = error;` at the top of the catch block, then reference `lastError?.message` here:
```suggestion
        throw new Error(`Model generation time budget exhausted: ${lastError?.message ?? 'unknown error'}`);
      }
```

_— qwen3.7-max via Qwen Code /review_

**[Suggestion]** The retry decision uses exact string matching against an error message thrown at line ~488, creating hidden coupling. If the message text is ever reworded at the throw site, content-validation errors silently become retryable — the check never matches, falls through to `!match → return true`, and up to `maxRetries` identical requests are wasted on a deterministic failure.

Concrete cost: a future reword of the error message silently reverts the fix this PR makes, with no compile-time or test-time signal.

Consider extracting the message as a module-level constant:
```js
const CONTENT_VALIDATION_ERROR_MSG = 'Model response did not contain message content.';
```
Then use it at both the throw site and this check.

_— qwen3.7-max via Qwen Code /review_

**[Suggestion]** The deadline-expired error template is constructed identically at three sites (lines 465, 500, 508), with an inconsistent source variable (`lastError` at line 465 vs `error` at lines 500/508) even though `lastError = error` makes them equivalent at the catch-block sites — Concrete cost: if the message format changes, three sites must be edited in lockstep; missing one produces inconsistent error text in CI logs, and the `lastError`/`error` discrepancy invites a future editor to "fix" one site without the others.

```suggestion
          throw deadlineError();
```

Extract a one-line helper before the loop: `const deadlineError = () => new Error(\`Model generation time budget exhausted: ${lastError?.message ?? 'unknown error'}\`);` and use it at all three sites.

_— qwen3.8-max-preview via Qwen Code /review_

**[Suggestion]** All three deadline-expired throw sites embed the original error's message as a string but discard the error object itself, losing its stack trace and type — Concrete cost: a CI run fails with "Model generation time budget exhausted: Model request failed with HTTP 503." The maintainer opens the stack trace and sees only the `throw new Error(...)` line; they cannot tell whether the 503 came from the initial fetch, a retry, or JSON parsing — the original error's stack, which would show this, has been replaced. Node.js ≥ 16.9 supports `Error(message, { cause })` and this project requires ≥ 22.

```suggestion
        throw new Error(
          `Model generation time budget exhausted: ${lastError?.message ?? 'unknown error'}`,
          { cause: lastError },
        );
```

Apply the same `{ cause: error }` pattern at the two catch-block sites (lines 500, 508).

_— qwen3.8-max-preview via Qwen Code /review_
